question: Which origin airport had the largest decline in on-time arrival performance from 2024 to 2025 among airports with at least 5000 departures in both years?
generated_sql:
WITH yearly_airport AS (

    SELECT
        Origin,
        year,
        COUNT(*) AS departures,

        100.0 * AVG(
            CASE
                WHEN is_on_time_arrival
                THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS on_time_pct

    FROM fact_flights

    WHERE
        year IN (
            2024,
            2025
        )

    GROUP BY
        Origin,
        year

    HAVING
        COUNT(*) >= 5000
),

airport_comparison AS (

    SELECT
        Origin,

        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN year = 2024
                THEN on_time_pct
            END
        ) AS on_time_2024,

        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN year = 2025
                THEN on_time_pct
            END
        ) AS on_time_2025,

        COUNT(
            DISTINCT year
        ) AS years_present

    FROM yearly_airport

    GROUP BY Origin
)

SELECT
    Origin,

    ROUND(
        on_time_2024,
        2
    ) AS on_time_2024,

    ROUND(
        on_time_2025,
        2
    ) AS on_time_2025,

    ROUND(
        on_time_2025
        -
        on_time_2024,
        2
    ) AS change_pp

FROM airport_comparison

WHERE
    years_present = 2

ORDER BY
    change_pp ASC

LIMIT 1
